body.x: Samsung Electronics(www.samsung.com) announced 'MICROSDXC UHS-I 64GB CLASS10' at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show that is being held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

The Samsung microSDXC Pro Memory Card adds storage capacity to your smartphone or tablet, giving you more space to store your favorite apps, media, and files. Boasting data transfer speeds up to 70 MB/s, the Samsung microSDXC Pro UHS-1 Class 10 Memory Card is ideal for high-end tablets and smartphones.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
